Priya: Heads up from Market St — cable car stopped at 4th, some loose tar pulled up and everyone had to jump out. umbrellas wrecked. anyone near 4th have spare? :umbrella_with_rain_drops:
Liam: yikes. I just dodged a flying umbrella handle. holding up at the coffee cart.
Nora: TransitBot said cable car suspended between 4th and Powell due to debris. no ETA.
TransitBot: ⚠️ Service alert: Cable car line interruption on Powell/Hyde and California lines. Crews en route. Expect delays and short-turns. https://sftransit/alerts/cc-101
Sam: if anyone needs dry shoes I have an extra pair (9) in my locker 2A. come grab.
Priya: @Sam hero. also, @Facilities, is there a mop? sneakers are leaving puddles. :sweat_smile:
FacilitiesBot: Supply update: mop + bucket will be at lobby desk in 6m. drying station open on 1F.
Marco: Caltrain app showing slow orders near South San Francisco. if you're heading south, consider driving or taking a shuttle.
Liam: thinking of walking to Embarcadero then ferry. anyone want to join?
Nora: ferry looks packed but moving. if you don't mind the damp breeze, it's scenic. :boat:
Priya: also FYI standup — we can do audio-only. my umbrella tried to become a modern art sculpture.
Sam: meme: "When your umbrella files for separation" https://i.imgur.com/fake-meme2.png :joy:
Liam: quick poll — anyone need a lift to 22nd St? I can swing by after coffee. reply with +1.
Marco: +1
Nora: +1 (but only if you have floor mats)
Priya: summary: cable car out, mop en route, spare shoes, ride offers. thanks team. :heart:
